title: Anthropic's Agent Billing: No More Free Autonomy
caption: Anthropic just pulled a fast one on AI agents: they're now explicitly billing for every single step. This means your 'autonomous' agent isn't just running free; it's racking up API calls that hit your bottom line. BUILD for the field guide to understand the shift.

slides.headline: Your AI Agents? They're Just *Another* API Call Now.
slides.sub: The real cost of agent autonomy just hit your bill.

slides.definition: An autonomous AI system that makes sequential API calls to achieve a goal, now explicitly integrated into Anthropic's billing structure.
slides.example: An agent researching market data might make 20 Claude 3 Opus calls, each adding to your monthly API usage.

slides.title: NO MORE FREE LUNCH FOR AUTONOMY
slides.body: Anthropic is now explicitly billing for agent actions within its API. Every call an agent makes to Claude, every tool use, every step in its reasoning chain – it all counts towards your usage.

slides.title: AGENT COSTS ARE *REAL* COSTS
bullets: Explicit Cost Tracking: No more guessing agent operational overhead.
Optimization Priority: Forces developers to build more efficient, less 'chatty' agents.
Transparency: Aligns agent operations with standard API billing practices.
slides.footer: Your autonomous agent isn't free to roam; its compute is on the meter.
